notes: NOT AN INSTALLED DOOR: a bare leaf leaning against a showroom wall, so every frame field is null with a reason. Skew 0.78, just above the usable limit - the leaf projects as a trapezoid 794 px wide at the top and 686 px at the foot, with the left edge 1896 px long against the right's 1702, so x fractions were taken against the LOCAL width at each feature's height. The three vertical lines ARE true milled grooves here (unlike d078 and d043): they read 0.3-0.4x the surrounding face, about 8 px wide, and run y 0.07 to 0.91. Flattest lighting in the set, contrast 1.62 - diffuse showroom light, which is exactly why it is the least useful record for how light falls.
